## Fixed

- **Label shadow shows.** The shadow under home screen and dock labels was so faint that turning it on or off made no visible difference. It is now a clear dark shadow, like Hyperion's.
- **Themed icons theme every app.** Apps without their own themed icon used to keep their colours. Now TheLauncher makes a themed icon from the app's icon, so every icon matches.
- **Custom icons work with themed icons.** With themed icons on, a picked icon was swapped back for the app's own themed icon, so picking seemed to do nothing. A picked icon now shows in the themed colours, and as picked when themed icons are off. A picture you chose for an app always stays as it is.
- **The assistant button in the drawer's search bar responds.** The search box lay over part of the button, so most taps opened the keyboard instead.
- **App closing animation plays every time you return home.** It only ran when swiping home onto an app's icon. "Fade in" now fades the home screen in, and "Suck in" plays too, whenever you leave an app (not when the screen turns on).
